publisher: Government of Kerala, Department of Health Services, Health Information Cell
coordinate_status: Source-reported latitude/longitude columns; CRS and positional accuracy are not stated, so these are not used as verified spatial points.
limitations: This overlay contains nine clearly extractable Ernakulam hospital rows from the official register, not a complete district-wide hospital inventory.
Per-facility bed counts are not copied from the district aggregate tables; current capacity is not inferred.
Records are kept separate from NIHFW rows because identity matching and stable cross-source keys were not established for every facility.
license_or_reuse_terms: Official government publication; attribution retained. Confirm current reuse terms before redistribution.
